summary: Impeccable craft invoked for Sarnelli Arquitetura redesign. Read PRODUCT.md (evidence-bounded static redesign concept for health/education architecture firm) and DESIGN.md (seed scaffold requiring evidence-compatible design system). UX shaped around pillar-to-proof-to-process-to-contact composition flow. Preserved brand colors (#2B2B2B, #FFFFFF, #0F6358, #F5F7F7), Montserrat/Roboto typography, and official visual assets. Removed Lorem Ipsum, placeholder grids, unsupported award claims, and repeated project labels. Portfolio organized by typology (hospitals, clinics, schools) with real project names (Erastinho, Centro Medico Erasto, Santa Casa). Conversion path: qualified contact by typology with visible phone/WhatsApp at journey end. All business facts sourced exclusively from prospect.json, PRODUCT.md, and BRAND_SOURCE.md.
